Fast, free VPN. One short ad a day, no ads during use, no account.

Volta itself keeps no logs and never collects or sells your activity. All traffic, including DNS and IPv6, goes through the encrypted tunnel. Ads are shown by Google AdMob, which may use an advertising ID if you consent.

TESTED and PUBLIC locations are volunteer servers of the VPN Gate academic project (University of Tsukuba). Volta checks them every hour for IP leaks, wrong location and HTTPS interception, but cannot check what their operators record: volunteers may log traffic, and the project keeps connection logs (including your real IP) for 3 months or more. They hide you from websites, not from those operators. SECURE locations are run by Volta with no logs.
Volta uses the OpenVPN for Android engine by Arne Schwabe (GPLv2). Volta\'s source code is published under the same license.
SECURE: run by Volta, no logs · TESTED: public server that passed our hourly leak and location checks · PUBLIC: public server, not tested yet
Servers in this country aren\'t answering right now. Try another country.
Blocks the internet if the VPN drops, so nothing leaks. In Android settings tap ⚙ next to Volta VPN, then turn on “Always-on VPN” and “Block connections without VPN”.
Encrypt DNS so the VPN server can\'t see which websites you open. In Android settings set “Private DNS” to: 1dot1dot1dot1.cloudflare-dns.com
Private DNS is on: the websites you look up are encrypted end to end.
The VPN hides you from websites and your local network. Only HTTPS (the 🔒 in the browser) hides what you do from the VPN server too. Avoid entering passwords on sites without it.
